title: #049. SMT-LIRA Mode Selection & Time Windows
subtitle: Couple Boolean courier-mode switches, integer express quotas, and continuous unloading times with disjunctive dock constraints in Z3.

judge.m0: Output must be an object { express, startTimes, endTimes, totalCost }.
judge.m1: express must be an array of {p0} booleans.
